competency_fulfillment.rationale: The lc asks students to read/write numbers up to 10,000 in numerals and words, and every sample correctly tests exactly that skill: 'Write 342 in words.' -> 'three hundred forty-two'.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: number_reading registers 2 combos (1 axis) for this node; my 5 samples are illustrative only, and exhaustive combo execution is machine-verified separately via validate_matrix.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Stems like 'Write 103 in words.' are 4 words, comfortably under the 22-word cap for grade 3 quarter 1, appropriate for a direct numeral-to-words conversion task.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: With only 1 axis / 2 combos registered, and all 5 sampled numbers landing in the 100-499 range, I can't confirm the variant space actually exercises 4-digit or near-10,000 values this lc's 'up to 10 000' wording requires.

competency_alignment.rationale: The word-form task directly matches 'read and write ... in numerals and in words' without drifting into place-value or pictorial-model territory that belongs to the sibling lc mat_g3_na_q1_0.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: All 5 sampled values (103, 142, 178, 342, 482) are 3-digit numbers well below 1,000; the competency's explicit ceiling is 10,000, and this small sample gives no evidence the range ever climbs into the thousands as grade 3 quarter 1 should demand.
